checks_passed.what_was_verified: Opened p02, p03, p04, p05, p15, p16, p18 and p19 and read every drawn structure against its IMAGE_EXTRACT SMILES atom by atom. All four aryl compounds are drawn with the acyl or methyl group at C1, nitro at C2 and methylsulfonyl at C4, which is what the SMILES encode (nitro ortho to the C1 group, sulfone two bonds further round). The dione drawn on p03 and p19 has its carbonyls two bonds apart, so 1,3 and not 1,4, matching O=C1CCCC(=O)C1. The enol ester is drawn with the ester oxygen on the alkene carbon and the ketone one carbon further round, i.e. 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl, matching OC2=CC(=O)CCC2. Mesotrione is drawn in the keto tautomer with the 2-position CH, not as the enol, matching C(=O)C2C(=O)CCCC2=O. No substituent position looks inferred rather than read.
